audit.why: EVEN / 6/10 fits 50.59% over 674 games. This is not a lane Gnar bullies — the early block already says so, correctly, since Teemo out-ranges Mini autos and blinds the step-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows contradicted the page's own whys, which each name their owner explicitly: whys[0] ends 'Gnar owns this early window' (stored Skill), whys[2] ends 'so it's Skill, not his' (stored Gnar), whys[4] ends 'tilts to Teemo's map control' (stored Skill), whys[5] says 'neither side cleanly owns' (stored Gnar), whys[6] says 'late goes to Teemo' (stored Gnar).
audit.why: The packet chart (Gnar/Gnar/Skill/Skill/Teemo/Skill/Teemo) matches the whys in all seven rows. Spikes stay as written: Gnar level 2, Rage-dependent middle, Teemo at 6 with shrooms and again on full build. Per the mirror, Rage governs the transform from level 1 — level 6 only adds GNAR! on top.
audit.corrected: win[0]=Gnar, win[2]=Skill, win[4]=Teemo, win[5]=Skill, win[6]=Teemo with matching phases sides, and phases[2], [4], [5], [6] whys rewritten. One atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page gets the important half right — the blind does not stop Boomerang — but never gives its cooldown, never says the Mega abilities also ignore it, and never states the passive that governs the whole side lane: Teemo goes invisible by standing still, and stays invisible while moving inside brush, leaving stealth with an attack-speed buff.
audit.why: 'Bait his Blinding Dart' is unactionable without the 7-second timer, and 'never facecheck unwarded brush' is a rule with no reason attached until you know he can move while invisible in it.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart (Q, 7s flat, 680 range) blinds basic attacks only — Boomerang, Wallop and GNAR! all land through it. Toxic Shot (E) is on-hit poison that scales with his attack speed, so armour alone reads the trade wrong. Guerrilla Warfare hides him while standing still and while moving in brush, with an attack-speed burst on exit. Noxious Trap slows and poisons; both sides carry displacement, so whoever lands GNAR! or a shroom first owns the trade.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Teemo must walk into your range.
edits.after: Blinding Dart (7s, 680 range) turns off your autos on step-up, so level 3 is even — poke with Boomerang only.

edits.before: Mega + R against a wall is the best engage top lane owns. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Teemo's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Shrooms arrive at 6 and zone the brush plus your Hop escape paths — this level is his, so carry a Sweeper and stop facechecking.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Blinding Dart's cooldown.
edits.after: First items trade even — Boomerang pokes freely, but Blinding Dart still kills your commit.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Teemo carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Full-build Teemo blinds your Mega autos and shrooms your escapes — he reclaims the 1v1, so fight with your team.

edits.before: Blinds autos — NOT your boomerang. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blind stops autos only — 7s at rank 1, and Wallop and GNAR! land through it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Shrooms slow and poison — they also block the brush you Hop through.

edits.before: Getting caught at zero rage right after Mega ends — that 15-second window is when Gnars die.
edits.after: He goes invisible standing still, or moving in brush — never facecheck his brush at low HP.

notes: No fabricated ability names on this page — the content layer is unusually clean here and the blind/Boomerang interaction was already correct. The work was the level chart (five rows disagreed with their own whys) and adding the numbers: Blinding Dart 7s / 680 range, and the fact that Wallop and GNAR! land through the blind, which is what makes the Mega all-in the win condition. The mirror (teemo__gnar) also notes that this matchup's focus block on the full layer points at 'Gnar GNAR!' with letters ['R'] — an ability that does not exist until 6 and only in Mega form. focus.text here is 'Teemo Blinding Dart' and is fine, but the letters sub-path is not in my writable list; someone with access should check the focus.letters value for this entry.
